attribution: Carnegie Mansion model · 3D Systems / Cooper Hewitt, Smithsonian Design Museum · CC0 1.0
scope: Simplified hollow exterior printing model. The textured FBX and full interior assets described on the official page are separate datasets and are not included here.
changes: None to the source STL. Display translation, lighting, monochrome presentation material and display scale are supplied at runtime.

inspection.unit: Not encoded in STL; numeric display coordinates only
inspection.axis: STL contains no axis metadata. Actual browser renders of the front, opposite side and roof confirmed that building height aligns with Y and that a display scale of 2 with X/Z centering and Y grounding is upright. This is a display-orientation observation, not a geographic-direction or physical-unit claim.

acceptanceBoundary: Asset integrity and license provenance verified. Browser loading, actual visual orientation, hotspots, interaction and performance require separate product acceptance; no engineering accuracy, current conditions or complete interior claim.
